purpose: Static source model, LBS, hierarchy and segmentation audit; no motion poses evaluated.
context7: SOMA-X resolve returned only unrelated TileDB-SOMA; official installed source and pinned model assets used.

definitions.model_parameters: SMPL-X shape/pose bases, joint regressor, hand PCA; SOMA shape bases and identity backend. Not correspondence network weights.
definitions.lbs: Vertex-by-joint nonnegative blend weights that deform each body mesh; inspected independently of labels.
definitions.segmentation: UMR discrete SMPL-X face labels and SOMA wrapper label transfer; categorical, not LBS.
definitions.common_labels: 18 categories: UMR 17 with neck separate from head/face; arm extra 19-way split deliberately excluded from LBS comparison.
definitions.common_lbs: Sum all joint LBS influences within each explicitly listed anatomical group, then compare group argmax with discrete source label.
definitions.disagreement: Not automatically an error: labels are hard anatomical partitions; LBS blends across boundaries and may assign mechanical influence outside them.
definitions.smpl_vertex_label: Majority incident raw55 face labels; lowest index wins a tie.
definitions.soma_vertex_label: Raw55 of nearest SMPL-X base-body face to corresponding SOMA_wrap vertex; upstream uses its 17-class collapse.
definitions.joint_label_semantics: SMPL-X Shoulder joint deforms upper arm; Collar deforms shoulder. SOMA Shoulder is clavicle; Arm upper arm. SOMA Leg thigh; Shin lower leg.

overlay.native_static_template: Neutral bind_shape posed by public T-pose transforms; not the MHR zero-identity forward mesh

wrapper_complete_nearest_triangle_check.note: Changes can include equal-distance shared-edge face ties; no upstream labels are replaced.

soma.wrapper_triangulation_note: Original polygon vertex order matches exactly; Trimesh quad diagonals differ from official triangles. UMR transfers vertex labels, so triangle identity is not required.
